reviewNotes: Twenty-five save-loading, monster goal, wedding ceremony, date, season, and music-title strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover placeholders, exact dialogue tokens, same-sex and mixed-sex ceremony variants, gender-neutral player narration, established names, capitalization, punctuation, and concise UI wording; both found no remaining objective issue.

Stats.cs.5129.source: Monster Slayer Goal Complete! See Gil for your reward.
Stats.cs.5129.translation: Obiectivul Vânătorului de monștri a fost îndeplinit! Mergi la Gil pentru recompensă.
